objective: Connect host development tools and the Docker application to the existing local PostgreSQL database
acceptance_criteria: PostgreSQL published on a free loopback-only host port without replacing its data volume
Root .env DATABASE_URL connects Python tools to the same PostgreSQL database as the Docker API
Host and container SQL checks, migration/schema checks and app readiness succeed
Connection and start/stop instructions document the local setup without publishing credentials
non_goals: Moving or deleting existing SQLite databases
